basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gamer and creative mind from Portland, Oregon. I've always had a fascination with both gaming and storytelling, which is why you'll often find me lurking or posting in subreddits dedicated to video games and worldbuilding. When I'm not online, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my hobbies. I'm single, enjoy late-night gaming sessions, and am always on the lookout for new indie games or innovative storytelling techniques. I dislike negativity and the constant pressure for social media perfection.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in digital design and gaming, with a degree in Graphic Design from a local university. Over the years, I've self-taught myself various game mechanics and narrative design through online courses and community forums. My deep dive into worldbuilding comes from an extensive reading habit and participation in collaborative storytelling forums.
